ntl15_semantics.SetSeed: Use full arbitrary precision signed ZZ value; canonical residue modulo M; map residue zero to one. No byte-array seed API found in this version.
ntl15_semantics.zrandom: For positive b, threshold M-(M mod b); repeatedly replace S by A*S mod M until S<threshold; return S mod b. Low residue, not high word.
ntl15_semantics.RandomBnd_ZZ: For bound>1, use floor((bitlength(bound)-1)/w)+2 accepted radix-2^w outputs, first output most significant; reduce concatenation modulo bound. Bound<=1 yields zero.
ntl15_semantics.RandomLen_ZZ: For requested length L>1, take ceil(L/w) accepted radix-2^w outputs, first output least significant; mask highest limb to L-(ceil(L/w)-1)*w bits and force highest requested bit to one. L<=0 yields zero; L=1 yields one without consuming RNG.
ntl15_semantics.RandomBits: No RandomBits symbol in recovered NTL 1.5 source. It must not be attributed an inferred implementation.
ntl15_semantics.default_radix: Largest even integer at most min(bits_per_long-2,double_precision-3); IEEE53 with long32 gives30; IEEE53 with long64 gives50; supported SINGLE_MUL forces26.
ntl15_semantics.P521_direct_RandomLen521_exclusion: GX has bitlength520, whereas every RandomLen521 output has bit520 set. This excludes only direct assignment without later transformations.
